write_scope: its unique external per-seat receipt under the cycle-2 receipt namespace
roles.boundary_contract: Hash separately the frozen target corpus, final review.md, Coverage evidence, review-role receipts, and external target-freeze author receipt, then hash their ordered package before decision. Write approval.json and then a unique approver receipt citing every component digest and package digest. Both outputs are outside attacker targets and must not be inserted retroactively. The approver does not approve its own receipt or any future closeout artifact.

required_behavior: Specialized mappings win before generic resolution; domainspec-implement remains code.

An exact installed capability without a specialized mapping resolves to canonical other while retaining capability id, skill path, skill digest, explicit authority mode, and tool profile in an immutable route receipt.
Missing, malformed, slash-qualified pseudo-capability, mismatched skill name/path, unavailable authority, missing route, forged route, and post-confirmation route swaps fail closed.
Malformed or failed code never degrades to other; every code opening retains the complete existing code_contract, readiness, write-scope, validation, group, and topology gates.

New canonical other rows use a bumped ledger schema version. API alias others normalizes new requests to other. Historical plural rows remain byte-for-byte readable, closable, and aggregatable without rewrite.
Appender validation, compile, open, host binding, and close verify the same capability-route digest.
Canonical sequential connections materialize ordered digest-bound downstream input manifests. Missing, stale, tampered, cross-capability, and unsupported connection inputs fail explicitly.

implementations/server/runtime/service.py accepts a workflow manifest only when route_digest is a valid sha256 digest equal to the opened dispatch row's capability_route.route_digest; absent, malformed, stale, cross-route, and mismatched values fail closed before artifact or dependency consumption.

implementations/server/runtime/legacy.py accepts opening schema versions 0.6.1, 0.6.2, 0.6.3, and canonical 0.6.4; preserves historical row bytes and behavior; and rejects missing, malformed, unknown, and higher versions with one explicit fail-closed supported-version error.

implementations/server/runtime/host_dispatch_hook.py synthesizes new automatic openings with registry-derived schema 0.6.4 and the canonical resolver's verified capability_route for the exact compatibility capability; dispatch_type and route digest agree through host binding, open, and close without changing existing role, model, prompt, anti-bias, or output-mode behavior.

New lifecycle fixtures use the registry's current schema, canonical singular other, and complete capability_route. Historical compatibility fixtures deliberately retain schema 0.6.3 and plural others and remain byte-stable/readable/closable rather than being silently modernized.

execution_state.historical_provenance_rule: Their existing receipts remain the authoritative producer provenance for their diffs. Reconciliation observes their current output after execution; it does not relaunch them, move them downstream of the reconciler, or convert their changes into user-owned work.
execution_state.resume_rule: A historical producer resumes only when a bounded verified finding requires its exact scope. Before mutation it verifies the reconciled current hash, preserves its original producer receipt, and emits a linked resume receipt that attributes all retained and new hunks.

execution_graph_status: SUPERSEDED_FOR_CYCLE_2: retained only as historical Stage-A topology; it has no launch, ordering, repair, review, approval, or closeout authority after this amendment.

cycle_2_execution.authority: SOLE_AUTHORITATIVE_CYCLE_2_ORDER; supersedes execution_graph and repair_contract.order in full for every remaining action.
authoritative_order: P1 PRELIMINARY REPAIR: original owners repair A-004/A-005 in parallel only within accepted exact scopes; disjoint test owners add the accepted cases.
P2 PRELIMINARY TEST: a_test_implementer runs the complete command set, persists a preliminary attempt receipt, and makes no terminal A-001 claim.

P3 PRELIMINARY RECEIPTS AND ONE RETRY: preserve PRE_INTEGRITY attempt 1 BLOCK; independently review this amendment; run both fresh bounded adoption re-audits; write all new linked correction/reaffirmation receipts with fresh identities; independently review the complete old-plus-new receipt graph; then and only then run the single PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY attempt 2, which writes lifecycle-manifest.pre-integrity.json only on PASS.

P4 PRELIMINARY INTEGRITY: BLOCKED until PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY attempt 2 PASS and the bounded pre-pin eligibility rule verifies. Then a_integrity_owner repins only the proven stale frozen integrity entries for repaired production/tests and accepted preliminary receipt evidence, including consequential local_pilot changes. Any functional failure or unexplained BLOCK fails closed before mutation.
T1 TERMINAL TEST: with preliminary integrity valid, a_test_implementer reruns the complete fixed and supplemental commands and atomically writes the full post-integrity terminal test report.
T2 TERMINAL PINS: a_integrity_owner pins the exact terminal report, derives final-hash-manifest claims only from persisted evidence, and reruns integrity to PASS; any report change returns to T2.

T3 PRE-REVIEW TARGET FREEZE: a_receipt_lifecycle_finalizer performs its second and last pre-approval attempt, atomically writes lifecycle-manifest.pre-approval.json plus a separate external author receipt, and freezes the complete attacker target corpus. The manifest excludes its own author receipt from content and hash.

T4 TERMINAL REVIEW DELIVERABLES: fresh fidelity/correctness/abuse attackers review only that frozen target corpus; writer and skeptic converge into review.md; coverage auditor audits target-by-lens coverage and survivor discipline. review.md and Coverage are downstream deliverables, not prior attacker targets.

T5 APPROVAL BOUNDARY: a_final_approver hashes the unchanged frozen target corpus plus final review.md, Coverage evidence, and the external target-freeze author receipt as one approval evidence package; writes approval.json, then a unique external approver receipt. None becomes an attacker target retroactively.

C1 POST-APPROVAL CLOSEOUT: a_post_approval_closeout_owner atomically writes lifecycle-manifest.closeout.json, cycle-2-completion.json, and a separate external owner receipt. The two closeout artifacts exclude that receipt from content/hash; the receipt hashes both artifacts. No substantive approval decision occurs.

C2 TERMINAL CLOSE: a_cycle_2_terminal_verifier checks the frozen target/package boundary, approver receipt, both closeout artifacts, and external closeout-owner receipt, then emits its own external PASS/BLOCK receipt. It neither includes nor approves itself.
cycle_2_execution.receipt_before_integrity_rule: Preliminary production/test receipts and lifecycle-manifest.pre-integrity precede preliminary integrity. The finite lifecycle-manifest.pre-approval contains only receipts already extant before attackers, through terminal integrity, and excludes its own atomic author receipt. Attacker, writer, skeptic, and coverage receipts are later external approval evidence; they are never backdated or inserted into either lifecycle manifest. Nothing overwrites preliminary evidence.

preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.functional_requirement: Every functional assertion and command that is not prevented by a frozen integrity-pin preflight must PASS. Tests reached before or outside the integrity gate must show no functional failure, error, timeout, unexpected skip, or contradictory result.
preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.sole_staleness_exception: A preliminary receipt may remain BLOCK and still be eligible for P4 only when every blocked command/failure is proven solely caused by stale frozen integrity pins. For each stale pin, evidence must name the manifest/pin artifact, exact pinned path, expected SHA-256, actual SHA-256, command and failure boundary, and demonstrate that execution stopped at integrity preflight before the guarded functional assertion. No other blocker may be present.
preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.proof_owners: a_test_implementer and any affected fixture/test reaffirmation owner record command-level proof; PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY independently checks it; a_integrity_owner recomputes every expected/actual hash before changing any pin.
preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.p4_action: P4 may update only the exact stale pins proven by this rule and their mechanically consequent parent pin. It may not waive, reinterpret, delete, or convert the preliminary BLOCK receipt to PASS.
preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.fail_closed: Any functional failure, mixed cause, missing expected/actual hash, execution beyond the claimed preflight boundary, unexplained BLOCK, receipt inconsistency, or changed artifact blocks P4 and requires coordination; no additional retry or broader repin is authorized.
preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule.terminal_requirement: After preliminary repin, T1 must rerun the mandatory complete command set from the beginning and write the full terminal report with every command PASS. T2 must pin that exact terminal report, rerun final integrity to PASS, and only then may pre-review freeze/review begin. Preliminary eligibility is never terminal test or Stage-A PASS evidence.

p3_evidence_repair_order: E1 Freeze and preserve all nine original seat receipts plus PRE_INTEGRITY attempt 1 BLOCK; verify their listed hashes before proceeding.
E2 a_p3_amendment_reviewer independently PASSes the amended contract hash; correction work is blocked before this PASS.
E3 Fresh legacy and host adoption auditors run independently in parallel and write distinct durable re-audit receipts.

E4 Fresh legacy adoption owner writes its new linked reaffirmation after legacy audit PASS; fresh host adoption owner writes after host audit PASS and after the legacy receipt exists, using that receipt's actual digest as sequential predecessor.

E5 Baseline, binding-test, compiler, service, fixture, and preliminary-test roles write only their authorized new linked reaffirmation/correction receipts with fresh unique identities; old receipts remain unchanged.
E6 a_p3_receipt_set_reviewer validates the complete old-plus-new graph and writes PASS/BLOCK external evidence.

E7 A fresh a_receipt_lifecycle_finalizer runs PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY attempt 2 exactly once. PASS writes lifecycle-manifest.pre-integrity.json and its separate atomic receipt; BLOCK writes only its immutable BLOCK receipt and stops before P4.
E8 After P4 and terminal pins, the separately authorized PRE_REVIEW_FREEZE attempt 3 runs once under the already accepted target-freeze rules.

unlock_requirements: p3-evidence-repair.amendment-review.md PASS at this amended contract SHA-256
both fresh durable adoption-auditor re-audit receipts PASS
all authorized fresh linked correction/reaffirmation receipts present
PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY attempt 2 PASS, lifecycle-manifest.pre-integrity.json written, and preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule proven for every retained preliminary BLOCK
p3_retry_gate.retry_denominator: Attempt 2 validates all nine immutable old seat receipts, immutable attempt-1 BLOCK, both new auditor receipts, every new correction/reaffirmation receipt, amendment-review hash, and correction-set-review receipt. Old defects remain recorded as corrected-by links rather than disappearing.
p3_retry_gate.failure: If amendment review, correction-set review, attempt 2, or the bounded preliminary pre-pin eligibility check is BLOCK, stop before P4. No second retry, receipt edit, denominator reduction, waiver, expanded exception, or silent omission is authorized.

evidence_boundaries.frozen_attacker_targets: Complete before attackers: repairs, tests, durable seat receipts through terminal integrity, preliminary and terminal integrity evidence, post-integrity terminal test report, final pins, and lifecycle-manifest.pre-approval.json. The manifest's own atomic author receipt is external evidence, not manifest content or attacker target.
evidence_boundaries.review_deliverables: Attackers and verifier/skeptic work produce final review.md; Coverage audits frozen target-by-lens coverage and survivor discipline. review.md, Coverage evidence, and their receipts are not attacker targets.
evidence_boundaries.approval: The approver hashes an approval evidence package consisting of the unchanged frozen attacker-target corpus plus final review.md, Coverage evidence, and the external target-freeze author receipt. Its approval artifact and receipt are external outputs referencing those exact component digests.
evidence_boundaries.post_approval: Mechanical closeout atomically adds lifecycle-manifest.closeout.json, cycle-2-completion.json, and a separate external closeout-owner receipt excluded from both artifacts' content/hash. Terminal verification checks those plus the approver receipt, then emits a self-excluded external verdict receipt. None modifies or joins targets/package retroactively.

cycle_2_execution.success_rule: Stage A cycle 2 succeeds only when a_final_approver returns PASS over the exact approval evidence package and a_cycle_2_terminal_verifier independently returns PASS over the immutable approval boundary plus mechanical closeout.
cycle_2_execution.stage_b_gate: Stage B remains blocked until both required PASS results exist and verify; cycle-2-completion alone, approval alone, or terminal-close verification alone is insufficient.

repair_contract.order_status: SUPERSEDED_FOR_CYCLE_2: repair_contract.order is historical recovery context only and must not be executed or used to resolve ordering.
superseded_order: a_baseline_repair_owner first reconstructs consumable evidence and freezes every current path without attributing interrupted residue. No auditor or production adoption owner starts from the invalid baseline.

Each fresh adoption auditor independently returns ADOPT or REIMPLEMENT for only its production diff. Its disjoint adoption owner either accepts the exact frozen bytes under a new receipt without mutation, or restores only unattributed hunks to last verified clean bytes and implements approved intent. Neither path may disturb user or other producer work.

a_post_adoption_reviewer independently PASSes repaired evidence, both decisions, both attributable receipts, implementation intent, and preservation before any fixture resume, test, or integrity action.

After post-adoption PASS, evaluate whether the historically completed a_legacy_fixture_migrator requires a bounded resume. If not, retain its prior terminal receipt; if so, verify reconciled hashes, link the resume receipt to prior provenance, update only its three exact fixture/test files, and preserve explicit historical 0.6.3/plural fixtures.

After the fixture resume decision is terminal, a_test_implementer updates only its two exclusive Stage-A files when required and runs the full fixed test contract across Stage-A, workflow, bridge, host-hook, ledger, service-validator, and integrity suites.
a_integrity_owner runs only after all repaired production and test bytes are final.
a_integrity_owner freezes one new final-hash manifest.
All three attackers, writer-skeptic convergence, coverage audit, and final approval rerun over exactly that manifest.
repair_contract.failure: Block after three unsuccessful cycles, any ownership collision, changed frozen recovery input, ambiguous actor attribution, inability to recover last verified clean bytes, scope expansion, dirty-hunk loss, or inability to preserve code readiness. Timeout or interruption records residue and leaves the affected seat non-terminal; it never transfers authorship or permits downstream launch.

dirty_overlap_policy.baseline_requirement: a_baseline records full pre-existing diffs and hashes for both paths before any Stage-A mutation.
dirty_overlap_policy.amendment_baseline_requirement: The interrupted reconciliation is invalid evidence, not provenance. a_baseline_repair_owner alone reconstructs it from the unchanged original baseline, the frozen interrupted artifact, current exact bytes/diffs, and independently verified durable receipts. The two production diffs remain explicitly unattributed until fresh adoption receipts exist. No earlier state, actor, or receipt may be inferred or invented. Only hunks present in the original baseline or supported by independent user-attribution evidence are user-owned; named Stage-A producer diffs retain their receipts.
dirty_overlap_policy.mutation_rule: Only a_integrity_owner may touch the known dirty integrity paths, only after baseline recovery, both adoption paths, independent post-adoption review, every triggered historical-producer resume, and the test owner are terminal, and only for the minimum manifest/pin changes required by final hashes.
dirty_overlap_policy.preservation_rule: Every original-baseline or independently attributed user hunk must remain semantically and textually preserved except exact hash/pin tokens that necessarily change. Every Stage-A producer hunk retains its named receipt provenance across reconciliation, resume, and integrity work. Record before/after hashes, attribution, and a hunk-by-hunk preservation check.
dirty_overlap_policy.block_rule: If a service, fixture, test, manifest, or pin edit overlaps semantically with an original-baseline or independently attributed user hunk, conflicts with a named Stage-A producer receipt, or cannot preserve attribution unambiguously, stop for coordination; do not overwrite, absorb, revert, normalize, reclassify, or silently modernize the dirty work.
dirty_overlap_policy.cycle_2_repair_rule: Before A-004/A-005 mutation, each original owner records the frozen current hash and complete existing diff for its exact file. Preserve every hunk outside the finding's bounded repair; retain original-baseline user attribution and named/reaffirmed producer attribution. test_host_workflow_binding.py begins clean at its frozen hash and may change only canonical opening setup plus A-004 assertions. Receipt and integrity owners never rewrite production/test hunks. Block on an intervening hash, ambiguous overlap, or missing attribution rather than reset, checkout, normalize, or reconstruct the file.

required_cases: Registry schema bump and canonical singular other for new rows.
API compatibility alias others normalizes to other without rewriting historical ledger bytes.
Mixed-version historical plural read, close, ledger aggregation, and UI aggregation.
Several exact installed unmapped capabilities resolve independently to other with retained identity/path/digest/authority/tool fields.
Specialized research, review, experiment, and code retain their specialized mappings.
Unknown capability, slash-qualified pseudo-capability, mismatched skill identity/path, unavailable authority, missing route, forged route, and post-confirmation capability swap fail closed.
Valid code passes only with its complete readiness fixture and canonical topology.
Missing/failing code readiness, write-scope escape, topology inflation, mixed code/other record, and code fallback attempt fail closed.
Appender, resolver, compile, open, bridge, host binding, and close verify the same route digest.

The orchestration service rejects a workflow manifest before consumption when route_digest is absent, malformed, stale, cross-route, or unequal to the expected immutable route digest, and accepts the exact matching digest.
Canonical sequential upstream output is materialized into the exact digest-bound downstream manifest.
Missing upstream output, stale/tampered manifest, cross-capability handoff, feedback, zig-zag, and unsupported edge semantics fail explicitly.

New workflow, bridge, and host-hook fixtures derive schema_version from the canonical registry, carry the resolved capability_route, use singular other for new openings, and preserve route_digest through compile/open/close.

Automatic production host-hook synthesis derives schema_version 0.6.4 from the canonical registry, resolves the exact installed compatibility capability, emits its complete capability_route, and requires opening dispatch_type to equal capability_route.dispatch_type.

Automatic production host-hook synthesis is accepted by the appender only with the verified route; missing, forged, mismatched, or post-resolution swapped capability_route and route_digest fail closed across host binding, open, and close.
Host-hook role, model, prompt, anti-bias, compatibility policy, output_mode, and existing binding/lifecycle behavior remain unchanged apart from the current schema and verified route attachment.
Dedicated historical fixtures remain schema 0.6.3/plural others, remain byte-for-byte historical, and prove read/close/aggregation compatibility without being accepted as new canonical openings.

Legacy opening resolution accepts canonical 0.6.4 and historical 0.6.1-0.6.3 rows, while missing schema_version, malformed values, 0.6.5, 1.0.0, and arbitrary unknown versions fail with the explicit supported-version error before lifecycle use.

A-004 positive: a sequential binding-output is accepted only when its canonical path, artifact id, data schema, sha256, bytes, producer binding/agent, dispatch, route digest, and producer-output receipt digest exactly equal the immutable output registered at terminal completion.

A-004 negative: arbitrary repository path, caller-created file, missing output receipt, nonterminal producer, wrong binding/agent/dispatch/artifact/schema/hash/bytes/route/receipt digest, symlink, cross-output substitution, and mutation after registration fail before manifest consumption.

A-005 positive: a current 0.6.4 close with exactly one valid opening and matching capability_route_digest succeeds; a uniquely resolved historical pre-route opening may close without that digest only under the explicit historical schema predicate.

A-005 negative: orphan close, absent ledger/opening, duplicate opening, malformed opening route, missing or malformed current route digest, mismatched/swapped digest, fake historical assertion, and validate-only orphan fixture fail closed without append.

A-001/A-002 evidence: terminal test report is created only after preliminary integrity is valid, contains the complete required metadata and PASS/BLOCK truth, and the final manifest pins that exact report plus the validated ordered lifecycle receipt-set digest.
Stage-E source-manifest and local-pilot integrity suites pass after final pins include every changed production and fixture/test file required by the manifest contract.
required_commands: repository-local Stage-E source-manifest integrity validation command discovered from the pinned manifest's existing test contract
repository-local local-pilot integrity validation command discovered from the existing local_pilot test contract
test_contract.evidence: The terminal test-report.json is a post-preliminary-integrity artifact and records for each exact command: started_at_utc, completed_at_utc, duration_ms, exit code, stdout/stderr byte counts and SHA-256 digests, cases covered, tested source-manifest and local-pilot hashes, lifecycle receipt-set digest, result, blockers, and final PASS/BLOCK. Preliminary runs remain separate immutable receipts and cannot replace it.

frozen_target_corpus: all Stage-A production paths changed within exact write scopes
the three migrated workflow/bridge/host-hook fixture-test files
the minimally merged stage-E source manifest
all unique durable cycle-2 seat receipts that exist through terminal integrity and no attacker/writer/skeptic/coverage/later receipt
external_evidence_available_to_attackers: the atomic a_receipt_lifecycle_finalizer author receipt for lifecycle-manifest.pre-approval.json, which hashes the manifest but is excluded from that manifest's content/hash and is not itself a target
boundary_exclusions: Coverage evidence as a prior target
review_contract.topology: Cycle 2 uses fresh identities. Three one-lens attackers review the already-complete frozen target corpus and feed the review writer; writer and stable skeptic exchange at most three times to create final review.md; coverage auditor proves every frozen target-by-lens cell and audits survivor/refutation discipline in the produced review. Neither review.md nor Coverage is treated as a pre-existing attacker target. The approver later consumes them as approval evidence deliverables.
review_contract.finding_rule: Every survivor quotes a target, has defensible severity and bounded fix. Refuted findings and transcripts are not persisted. Zero findings requires explicit target-by-lens defense.
review_contract.pass_rule: No CRITICAL or MAJOR finding remains; A-001/A-002/A-004/A-005 each have exact closure evidence; coverage is complete; terminal post-integrity tests, lifecycle receipts, and final integrity PASS; manifest claims agree with persisted evidence; and target hashes equal final-hash-manifest.json.

receipts.unique_path_rule: Each attempted seat writes only `<namespace>/seats/<role_id>/<agent_id>/<attempt_id>.json`; role_id, agent_id, and attempt_id are filesystem-safe and the tuple is globally unique. Reaffirmations and post-integrity reruns use new attempt ids and link, never overwrite, prior attempts.

p3_correction_receipt_contract.amended_contract_binding: Every new receipt uses the SHA-256 of this evidence-repair amendment after independent amendment review PASS, not source hash BEF303...; approved_parent_sha256 remains exactly 2D9C9C3B3ACD66D0A0C11DF69F2BC9265B45A3384BB7C317D7F76F78CB342051. Both fields are mandatory and semantically distinct.
fresh_identity_paths: one fresh unique reaffirm-02 path each for a_baseline_repair_owner, a_binding_output_test_owner, a_compiler_implementer, and a_manifest_service_implementer
p3_correction_receipt_contract.fixture_test_required_fields: The fixture and preliminary-test reaffirmations must satisfy every global per_seat_required_fields entry plus the role-specific amendment requirements. A retained preliminary BLOCK is eligible for P4 only under preliminary_pre_pin_eligibility_rule: all ungated functional assertions/commands PASS and every remaining failure is exclusively a named stale frozen pin with expected/actual SHA-256 and proven preflight boundary. It remains BLOCK and is never converted to PASS.
p3_correction_receipt_contract.predecessor_rule: The new host owner receipt is created strictly after the new legacy owner receipt. It stores legacy receipt path and exact SHA-256 in sequential_predecessor and receipt-link validation recomputes that digest from disk.
p3_correction_receipt_contract.immutability: No new correction receipt may share an agent_id with another role, reuse an old path/attempt, overwrite bytes, claim supersession/deletion, or omit the old receipt from the complete retry denominator.

required_frozen_target_receipt_seats: every recovery/adoption seat whose bytes remain in the frozen corpus
required_review_deliverable_receipt_seat: a_receipt_lifecycle_finalizer PRE_REVIEW_FREEZE author receipt external to its manifest
receipts.historical_producer_receipt_rule: Existing terminal receipts for runtime, compiler, service, and fixture producers remain authoritative and are not regenerated by reconciliation. If one is explicitly resumed, its new receipt must cite the prior receipt, verified reconciled input hash, retained-hunk attribution, new changes, and terminal output hash; absence of a resume retains the historical receipt unchanged.
receipts.interruption_receipt_rule: Record the first reconciler timeout/interruption and finalizer BLOCK as residue with attempted agent id, observed hashes, incomplete work, timeout/interruption status, and no-authorship/no-adoption declaration. An interrupted or timed-out receipt is never terminal PASS and cannot authorize downstream work.
receipts.pass_condition: At the approval boundary: cycle is 2; approver verdict is PASS over the ordered evidence package; A-001/A-002/A-004/A-005 are closed; critical_count and major_count are zero; frozen-target receipts are terminal and validated by the finite pre-review lifecycle manifest; target-freeze author receipt is external and valid; review/coverage receipts are separately terminal; terminal report follows preliminary integrity; final repin follows terminal report; and all target hashes, tests, integrity, review coverage, authority disclosures, and dirty-hunk preservation checks verify. Overall success additionally requires later terminal-close verifier PASS.
receipts.stage_b_handoff: Stage B remains prohibited until both a_final_approver PASS over the ordered evidence package and a_cycle_2_terminal_verifier PASS independently verify. Post-approval closeout evidence remains external and never becomes an attacker target or approval-package member retroactively.

terminal_conditions: Minimum runtime support is installed only within the exact scopes.
All fixed tests and integrity commands pass.
The complete post-integrity terminal test report is pinned by a later final integrity manifest whose claims match it exactly.

Every frozen-target seat has a unique durable receipt or explicit non-PASS interruption residue before target freeze; later review, approval, closeout, and verifier seats use external receipts at their actual times; none is backdated into an earlier manifest and no past receipt is invented.
A-004 producer-output provenance and A-005 orphan-close fail-closed behavior pass their exact negative cases.
Every direct Stage-A seat is honestly labeled non-ACI and has terminal join/close evidence.
The complete frozen corpus passes the canonical multi-lens review graph.

approval.json is PASS and hashes the unchanged frozen attacker-target corpus plus separately produced final review, Coverage evidence, review-role receipts, and target-freeze author receipt as one ordered approval package, without including itself or later closeout artifacts.
Mechanical post-approval closeout preserves that corpus digest, and the independent terminal close verifier is PASS without requiring self-inclusion.
